front.title: The AI-Decision-Receipt HTTP Response Header Field

abstract.t:
Automated systems, including AI models and AI agents, increasingly make decisions and take actions that affect people, money and data. Emerging work on agent identity answers which agent made a request and whether it was authorised. It does not give the parties involved a portable, independently checkable record of what was decided.
This document defines AI-Decision-Receipt, an HTTP response header field that carries a compact receipt for a governed automated decision: the outcome, a fingerprint of the exact request the decision was made on, the position and hash of the record in the issuer's tamper-evident log, and a location where anyone can verify that record without trusting the issuer. The field uses the Structured Field Values for HTTP Dictionary type.
